scripts.build: npm --prefix strands-bridge run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix strands-bridge ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix agentcore/cdk ci
scripts.agentcore:validate: agentcore validate --json && npm --prefix agentcore/cdk run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix strands-bridge test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix strands-bridge run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
